en.html:
I drag my wandering attention back.

Time has become terribly expensive. Waste one instant now, not a mountain of gold will buy it back.

Check the surroundings again.

Seven enemies. Six down.

—One still remains!

At the right edge of my sight, Misao Oji opens her mouth as far as it will go. A scream is coming.

Before hearing it, I follow her eyes.

The back of the garage—

A man running toward a large, almost rectangular box. The last masked man.

In his hand—round—small—like a fruit—

A grenade.

His arm draws back. Aimed at the box.

A Crus case. Across it, AVENGE is scrawled in marker.

I hold her down.

Too late. His movement, the distance, the time—every part of the calculation gives that same answer.

...I refuse to listen.

The throw.

Impact.

en.html:
A scene from long ago returns. So far away now.

Lying in the brush, gun ready, staring in frantic fear. That world—frozen and convulsing at once.

In those days, this smell was the air itself.

The sharp stink of gunpowder.

Smoke thinning.

Shattered pieces of something.

Someone pressed against me understands. In one instant.

Grieves. In one instant.

The enemy soldier is triumphant. Above his cheap mask, the uncovered eyes are twisted.

I spring forward.

Perhaps I shout something. Perhaps not a word comes out.

Perhaps somebody else's voice becomes my own in my ears.

Run.

The man turns. Jumps back, trying to escape.

Follow.

—Drive through.

Struck deep in the pit of the stomach, he tumbles down and vomits.

Most of the attackers are unconscious. The others are in no condition to speak either. Questions will have to wait for their answers to become physically possible.

Three staff members are injured. All minor injuries. The first-aid box comes out and simple treatment begins.

Soon finished, that. Afterward, there are people who need the box much more urgently. But I doubt it will be offered to them. From my side also, no recommendation will come.

Weak sobs strike my ears.

What is there to say?

How much Misao Oji loved the tsurugi called Avenge, and why—I have seen it myself.

Even those who do not know seem to understand. Ichijou's expression is hard. If the anger inside her keeps accelerating, soon she may bite through her own lip. Before that happens, I must stop her.

Captain Ootori is studying her gun's muzzle like a reformed murderer regretting the decision to become a priest. Or somebody who left her humanity in her mother's womb, or up in heaven, and has only now remembered she never collected it.

The attendant, Nagakura, stands beside her, deep in thought.

The self-declared Liger picks up a piece of wreckage and examines it.

...What is going on in that girl's mind, I cannot tell.

ja.html:
……今となっては遠い、昔の光景を思い出した。
　藪の中に伏せ、銃を構え、怯え狂いながら見詰めて
いたあの――凍りついた、激動の世界。

　あの時、この匂いは空気そのものだった。
　火薬のもたらす刺激臭。

　薄れゆく煙。
　粉々になった、何かの破片。

　肌を触れ合わせている誰かの、瞬間的な理解。
　瞬間的な慨嘆。

　勝ち誇る敵兵。
　粗末な覆面が隠さない目元は歪んでいる。

　飛び出す。
　何か喚いたかもしれない。無言だったかもしれない。

　誰かの声を自分のものと取り違えたかもしれない。
　駆ける。

　男が振り返った。
　飛び下がって、逃げようとする。

　追う。
　――貫く。



　鳩尾の更に中心を打ち抜かれた男はもんどり打って
倒れ、胃液を吐いた。


　襲撃者の大半は意識を手放している。
　そうでない男も、口を利ける状態にはなかった。話
を聞くにはしばらく待たねばならぬらしい。

　スタッフ達に負傷者は三名。いずれも軽傷。
　救急箱を持ち出して簡単に手当てを始めている。

　それはすぐに済むだろう。
　だがその後で彼らよりも切実に手当てを欲している
ことは疑いない人々に、救急箱が差し向けられるとは
思われなかった。俺もあえて勧めようとも思わない。


　嗚咽が耳を叩いていた。
　弱々しく。

　かける言葉もない。
　その少女、皇路操が、あのアベンジという名の劔冑
にどれ程の愛情を注いでいたか、それは何故であった
のか、俺は目の当たりにして知っている。

　知らぬ人間にしても同じだ。
　一条の表情は険しい。内心の憤懣があのままに加速
すると自分で自分の唇を噛み切る時も遠くないだろう。
そうなる前には止めてやる必要がある。

　大鳥大尉はといえば、これは更生して神父になった
ことを悔んでいる元殺人鬼のような顔で銃口を眺めて
いた。人間性というものを母の胎内か天上に置き忘れ、
今更それに気付いたような顔つきでもある。

　永倉侍従はその傍らで沈思。

　自称ライガー女史は残骸を手にとって調べていた。
　
　……あの少女が何を想っているのかはわからない。

en.html:
Ichijou kicks the floor with her toe. Against the explanation, or against the girl giving it? I cannot tell.

The girl is right. Question these masked men, and a useful company name or person's name will probably not come out. Even if one does, it must be accepted as evidence in court. Otherwise, bas. There the matter ends.

If the shogunate's shadow is behind Shokyo—and expecting it to remain politely a shadow is already too much—then a fair trial is a thing beyond our reach.

These actual attackers we intend to send to Kamakura station. How long they will stay in detention is another matter.

Although, for them, some punishment has already been received. That much one could say.

Someone stands beside me. A slender figure. A face with no expression left.

Suguru Oji.

Naturally, he has not come to speak to me. He looks down at his beloved daughter, sobbing as weakly as a little bird near death. Words are not coming to him, it seems.
en.text:
Ichijou kicks the floor with her toe. Against the explanation, or against the girl giving it? I cannot tell.

The girl is right. Question these masked men, and a useful company name or person's name will probably not come out. Even if one does, it must be accepted as evidence in court. Otherwise, bas. There the matter ends.

If the shogunate's shadow is behind Shokyo—and expecting it to remain politely a shadow is already too much—then a fair trial is a thing beyond our reach.

These actual attackers we intend to send to Kamakura station. How long they will stay in detention is another matter.

Although, for them, some punishment has already been received. That much one could say.

Someone stands beside me. A slender figure. A face with no expression left.

Suguru Oji.

Naturally, he has not come to speak to me. He looks down at his beloved daughter, sobbing as weakly as a little bird near death. Words are not coming to him, it seems.

有意義な証拠として取り上げられなければそれまでだ。

そんな控えめな在り方など期待できないなら尚のこと

と言えなくもない。

死期を迎えた小鳥のようなか細い嗚咽をもらす愛娘を
見下ろしている。言葉を探しあぐむ風だった。

en.html:
Their doing, certainly. Muramasa no longer needs to inspect Tamura's reserve machine.

I must still ask whether Silver Star's presence remains. Had this reserve been the host, that presence should have vanished. But such a convenient result seems very unlikely.

A tsurugi given an egg also receives a little of Muramasa's ability. One grenade comes, and it obediently blows apart? Too poor a performance.

...Which means it is almost settled now.

Tomorrow, in the Yamato GP final, I will be entering.

確かに、彼らのお陰だ。
　もうタムラの予備騎を村正に調べさせる必要はない。

　銀星号の気配が未だ在るか、そのことは訊ねておく
必要があるが。
　この予備騎が寄生体であったのなら消失している筈
――だが、よもやそれはあるまいと思えた。

　あの〝卵〟を得た劔冑は村正の能力の片鱗をも獲得
する。
　手榴弾一個で素直に爆破されてしまうのはお粗末に
過ぎた。

　……つまりは、ほぼ決定したと云える。
　明日の、大和ＧＰ決勝戦への、俺の参加が。

—it should come true.

Dreams also have no respect for timing. In this world one cannot lower one's guard.

The boy who wanted this has long since stopped asking. Now the answer arrives, and the grown man must deal with it. Bhai, at least confirm the address. Desires do not remain sitting in the same place forever, waiting politely to be fulfilled.

Apparently mine had left no forwarding instructions.

Oji"...Misao. As you said, this machine is everything to your father."
Misao"..."
Oji"One minute, twenty-five point one three. You know it, no, Misao?"
Misao"...Haan. Nuvolari..."

Oji"That level I am challenging. I wanted the world's summit and could not reach it. Against that past, I will strike back."
Misao"..."
Oji"Shokyo's toys I do not consider opponents. Only the world's highest point is my target..."
Oji"For that, Avenge. For that, you."
Oji"Both of you I will protect. Without fail."
Misao"...Father..."
Oji"So... go beyond it. Show me."
Oji"The world's limit. Complete my revenge, Misao."
Misao"..."
Misao"...Yes. Father..."
Misao"Tomorrow... I will win. Definitely. And then... the world..."
Oji"Yes..."
Kageaki"............"

en.html:
—The world, is it.

The world's highest point.

To be there, alone.

People captured by that dream want speed. Faster than anybody, faster than everyone.

Leave all the others behind. Obtain solitude.

People who gave up the dream watch the backs of those who did not. From the stands, they put their lost dream into a racing silhouette.

But between the two, the distance is too much.

...After all, an armour racer is not what I am made to be. In childhood I certainly dreamed of it. But somewhere along the way, without even noticing, I gave up. Forgot.

That lonely world.

ja.html:
――世界、か。

　世界の頂点。
　そこに、ただ独りで在るということ。

　その夢に魅せられた者が速さを望む。
　誰にも優る速度を求める。
　
　他の全てを突き放し、孤立を得るために。

　その夢を諦めた者は、諦めなかった者の背を眺める。
　観客席から、疾走する騎影に己の失われた夢を託す。
　
　だが、両者の距離は余りにも遠い。

　……やはり俺は、<ruby>装甲騎手<rt>アーマーレーサー</rt></ruby>の器ではないのだ。
　子供の頃、確かに夢見ていた筈なのに、いつの間に
か諦めて忘れ去っていたのだから。

　孤独な世界を。
